name: Syne
summary:
Syne is an independent rhythm game created and solo-developed by ZXZ. First developed in 2026, it is built around a 3D playfield that tilts and shifts with the music, combining precise timing with spatial movement. Players interact with notes as they travel toward a catch line, creating a gameplay experience focused on both rhythm and aim.

The game features four distinct gamemodes, each offering its own approach to playing along with music. Players can compete through ranked play and leaderboards, create and share their own beatmaps, and participate in real-time multiplayer. Syne is currently available in closed beta for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
